context.hint: Enforce source visibility in bundles, maps, and release provenance.
context.surface: A build publishes separate client and server artifacts and a manifest under an explicit source policy.
assumptions: Use a disposable release fixture with fake private markers and documented public outputs.

review.invariant: Private values are excluded from the release even when used within private module code.
review.verification: Include a synthetic marker inside a private module and check the final output inventory. Prefer keeping private logic and runtime configuration outside distributed bundles.

source_observation.summary: A follow-up found that checking exported constants alone missed a private fixture value. The revised release layout passed the focused output and visibility checks.
